```python
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Descriptors, rdMolDescriptors
s='CCCCC[C@H](O)/C=C/[C@H]1[C@H](O)CC(=O)[C@@H]1CCCCCCC(=O)O'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
print('canonical_smiles:', Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
print('formula:', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print('MW:', round(Descriptors.MolWt(m),2))
print('cLogP:', round(Descriptors.MolLogP(m),2))
print('TPSA:', round(rdMolDescriptors.CalcTPSA(m),2))
print('HBD:', rdMolDescriptors.CalcNumHBD(m), 'HBA:', rdMolDescriptors.CalcNumHBA(m))
print('rotatable_bonds:', rdMolDescriptors.CalcNumRotatableBonds(m))
print('carboxylic_acid:', any(a.GetSymbol()=='O' and a.GetTotalNumHs()>0 for a in m.GetAtoms()))
```
